item.title: Bitcoin Holds Near $78,479 as Pakistan Regulation and Coinbase Mortgages Surface
item.summary: BTC/USD closed at $78,479.14 at 20:00 UTC on August 26, down 0.572004% over 24 hours per Alpaca, as headlines surfaced around Pakistan's new crypto regulatory framework, Coinbase's expanded Bitcoin-backed mortgages, and BlackRock's reported custody of 765,000 BTC.
